long_biography.plain_text:
In 1994, Jeff Bezos left quantitative finance to build an online bookshop, choosing books because their vast catalogue suited a searchable web database. Amazon grew from that focused idea into a technology platform spanning commerce, devices and cloud computing. Bezos led the company as chief executive before becoming executive chair.

Bezos founded Blue Origin in 2000 around the goal of making spaceflight safer, cheaper and more routine. Its engineering programme centres on reusable launch vehicles designed to reduce the cost of reaching space. That work now includes reusable launch systems, lunar landers and in-space mobility systems.

Amazon grew from that focused idea into a technology platform spanning commerce, devices and cloud computing. Bezos led the company as chief executive before becoming executive chair.

Bezos founded Blue Origin in 2000 around the goal of making spaceflight safer, cheaper and more routine. Its engineering programme centres on reusable launch vehicles designed to reduce the cost of reaching space. That work now includes reusable launch systems, lunar landers and in-space mobility systems.
